text:
Priya: quick sync \/ short thread \u2014 we need to finalize post-launch iteration rules for the next two sprints. main split: emergency customer fixes vs. polish.
Ben: +1. let's avoid ad-hoc debates per ticket. need clear decision ladder.
Carlos: ladder idea = impact * reproducibility * customer-count. if impact >= enterprise-critical OR CI reproduces -> fast lane. else schedule into enhancement wave.
Tara: perf regressions are special. any change that bumps p99 > 15% or increases CPU > 25% -> auto-escalate.
Aisha: customers asked for predictable SLAs. propose "48/5": 48h ack, plan in 5 business days. delivery = target next 2 sprints unless infra/security.
Priya: agree. also reserve a rotating fast-lane slot: 1 engineer per sprint for triage & quick fixes.
Ben: rollout guardrails: canary staircase 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with checks at each step. ops-bot posts results.
ops-bot: canary pipeline created: redwood/canary-staircase v2. smoke jobs queued. :robot_face:
Carlos: adding release checklist to runbook:
```
- unit/integration smoke
- canary smoke (latency + errors)
- pilot verification (if customer-impact)
- quality eval vs baseline (hallucination, accuracy)
- rollback window + owner
```
Tara: who owns rollback? ops oncall + release engineer. we'll add explicit owner fields per release card.
Priya: owners template: quality = Carlos, customer comms = Ben, release = Tara, monitoring = ops-oncall. fill names on cards.
Aisha: backlog grooming tweak: tag with "customer-impact", "dev-days", "acceptance-criteria". pre-groom 20m to surface top 10 by impact/dev-days ratio.
Ben: acceptance criteria must include a telemetry assertion (e.g., no >5% increase in error rate) in addition to functional tests.
Carlos: for temporary model tweaks (quantization), require a hallucination check on eval set; reject if > baseline + 2%.
Priya: escalation rule: do not expand scope if >1 outstanding P1 or any active customer-blocking regression.
Aisha: pilot volunteers: Acme, Nuvem, BrightData. will coordinate canary flags and feedback doc.
Tara: timeline: by EOD add dev-day estimates and acceptance criteria to sprint cards. confirm at 11am huddle.
Ben: on it.
Carlos: updating runbook and checklist now.
ops-bot: reminder set for 11:00 \/ Post-launch iteration huddle.
Priya: thanks all. keep it tight. :thumbsup:
